newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-New Australia wool group nearing start-up.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-New Australia wool group nearing start-up.

text.p: The partners in the proposed Global Wool Ltd wool marketing and handling joint venture said on Monday they expect to start operations July 1, the start of Australia's next wooling season, subject to certain conditions.

The partners -- Elders Ltd, Wesfarmers Dalgety Ltd and Wool International -- said a number of commerical and regulatory hurdles still existed before the proposal could proceed. These include approval by the Australian Competition and Consumer Commission and discussions with industry groups.
The proposal aims to combine efforts to develop a forward market in wool.
Wesfarmers Dalgety would continue to compete with Elders for wool rowers' business, the companies said in a statement.

Global Wool will use some of the existing woolstores of both companies in its wool handling businesses but the rural networks of Elders and Wesfarmers will remain in place and continue to compete, the statement said.
An estimated 85 to 95 percent of all Australian wool is currently sold on a spot basis.
Elders and Wesfarmers Dalgety account for around 60 percent of the auction-based movement of wool in Australia.
